comment: The revert-check of the `change-readiness` capability (`tools/check-change-readiness.sh`): one record per refusal the checker can print — `declaration-missing`, `open-decision`, `scenario-without-case`, `surface-missing`, `surface-command-missing`, `change-unreadable` — plus one record for the rule that makes the whole capability safe, that the checker reads the `## Open decisions` declaration and never a section for its meaning, so a real in-flight `## Open Questions` deferral is not a refusal. Run it with `bash tools/mutate.sh --mutations tools/check-change-readiness-mutations.json`; `.pi/skills/revert-check` owns the rule and `.pi/skills/mutation-runner` owns how. `case-cmd` runs one named case (`--case {case}`), so a mutation pays one case and not the suite. Every search is a single line and unique in its file, because the runner's replacement is literal and line-based, and the file is restored byte for byte afterwards; `tools/loop/loop.conf` maps this list to the checker's path, so editing the checker runs it.

mutations.label: declaration-missing
mutations.why: a change that carries no `## Open decisions` section is refused by name, because an omitted declaration and a declaration of `none` are different claims and only one of them can be checked

mutations.label: open-decision
mutations.why: a declaration whose first non-empty line names a decision is refused with that line, so a change that leaves a worker a fork is not reported ready

mutations.label: scenario-without-case
mutations.why: every `#### Scenario:` in the change's spec delta owes a `**Case**:` line, because a scenario with no case is a plan for a test that does not exist

mutations.label: surface-missing
mutations.why: a proposal with no line beginning `surface:` is refused, because an estimate made before the surface is counted is the defect the count exists to prevent

mutations.label: surface-command-missing
mutations.search: if ! printf '%s\n' "$surface_text" | grep -q '`[^`]\+`'; then record surface-command-missing
mutations.why: a surface line that quotes no command is refused, because a count a reader cannot re-take is a number with no measurement behind it

mutations.label: change-unreadable
mutations.why: a change directory that carries no design.md is refused by name instead of being read as a change that declares nothing, so a missing document cannot pass as a clean one

mutations.label: deferral-is-not-a-fork
mutations.search: if (tolower($0) ~ /^##[ \t]+open decisions[ \t]*$/) { ins = 1; heading = NR; next }
mutations.replace: if (tolower($0) ~ /^##[ \t]+open questions[ \t]*$/) { ins = 1; heading = NR; next }
mutations.why: the checker reads the `## Open decisions` declaration and never the meaning of a section, so the deferral 8 of 15 in-flight designs carried is not a refusal; a checker that read `## Open Questions` would refuse 53 % of the open set
